figures.caption: Figure 1: The overview of Miras framework. Miras is based on four critical choices of (1) memory architecture, (2) attentional bias, (3) retention gate, and (4) memory learning algorithm. In this framework, the memory architecture determines the model capacity to memorize; attentional bias is responsible for modeling the underlying mapping patterns; retention gate determines how to balance learning new concepts and the retention of previously learned concepts; and memory learning algorithm is responsible for memory management.
